text: The Patriots' turnover troubles cost them dearly in Thursday's 30-24 loss to the Bears, with Caleb Williams throwing two touchdown passes to lead Chicago to victory—a particularly stinging defeat given that Mike Vrabel has identified turnover differential as one of the four pillars of his team identity. As New England looks ahead to Sunday's 4:15 PM ET matchup against the Dolphins in Miami (with broadcast information noting a 4:25 PM ET start time), the team made several roster adjustments this week, re-signing linebacker Jose Ramirez to the practice squad while releasing offensive lineman Jacob Rizy from the practice squad and punter Bryce Baringer from injured reserve. Running back Rhamondre Stevenson continues to quietly excel in the Patriots' backfield, doing the little things right and approaching his sixth straight season with 100-plus carries, though his efforts will need to be complemented by better ball security across the board if New England hopes to turn things around against Miami.
